note: The graph spec's list of formats (editor spec §51, spec_formats_listed). Every format a graph is read from or written to is here. Each says what it keeps, what it drops, and the test that round-trips it. test/graph-spec-formats.test.js holds the code to this list.

formats.keeps: every thing and link, each kind and property, and the notes written on them
formats.drops: layout, and a guess the drawing made

formats.keeps: every thing and link, each kind and property with the kind of its values
formats.drops: the notes on things and links, which CSV has no comments for, and layout

formats.keeps: every thing and link, each kind and property, and the notes written on them
formats.drops: layout, and a guess the drawing made

formats.keeps: the picture as drawn, with the id of each thing it shows
formats.drops: properties and notes: a picture is not data, so it does not read back
everything but pixels: it does not read back

formats.keeps: every cell, the line each row starts on, and cells past the header, listed as uneven
formats.drops: nothing from a file within the limits; a file over them is refused whole

formats.keeps: each row of the things query as a thing, each row of the links query as a link, written as a GQL block copy
formats.drops: any live link to the database: the copy is text and nothing in it runs again

formats.keeps: the things and links the text states
formats.drops: wording that states neither a thing nor a link
